title: Data and code for: What a sample's energy certifies about quantum-generated training labels
description: Replication package of the article What a sample's energy certifies about quantum-generated training labels by Nicolás Bonilla Vargas. It contains the sources of the article and of its Supplemental Material; a converted copy, with checksums, of the public data of the dataset studied (arXiv:2606.15983; repository github.com/bjader/quantum-groundstate-learning at commit 6b8866b, Apache-2.0), and the pinned archive of that repository; the declared analysis of those data (certification map, tests of the bias, learning tests) with its code, written protocol, outputs and independent checks; the certificates behind every statement proved in exact arithmetic, with two exact verifiers; the earlier map built from the published figures, the classical emulation, the author's processor run, the second benchmark and the tests declared in advance; the scripts and outputs of the numerical checks of the proofs; and the scripts that make every figure and generated table. Every number printed in the article carries a source comment in the LaTeX files; paper/check_numbers.py re-checks the printed numbers against the stored files, docs/NUMBERS_TO_FILES.tsv lists every stored file cited with the lines that cite it, and docs/MANIFEST.tsv gives the SHA-256 of every file. python run_checks.py re-runs the checks that need no cloud machine. What is not included and how to regenerate it is in docs/LEFT_OUT.md. Code under the MIT licence; text, figures, data and documentation under CC BY 4.0; third-party material keeps its own licence (file NOTICE).
